_about: hotkey.py and explain_hotkey.py's values (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Loaded once at import and checked by json_config.py: a bad value logs one warning naming the key and the default used instead (the defaults are hotkeys.defaults.json, the same values this file ships with; scripts/test_hotkey.py keeps the two equal). DENISSE_HOTKEYS_CONFIG points at another file. The env vars DENISSE_HOTKEY / DENISSE_EXPLAIN_HOTKEY still override the combos here. Keys starting with _ are notes.

summon._about: Opens the chat from any app. combo: modifiers and one key joined by +, or one of off_words.

explain._about: Sends the front app's selection to the chat. prefix starts the message; release_wait_s: how long to wait for Alt/Shift/Win to come up before Ctrl+C; send_wait_s: how long a fresh chat may take to connect before the text is left in the box; send_retry_ms: how often to retry meanwhile.
explain.off_note: Reading the screen is switched off (DENISSE_DESKTOP_CONTEXT=0), so I didn't look.

modifiers._about: Words accepted for each modifier in a combo.
